correctness.rationale: A 28-144-156-cell Abrams-type two-particle model is explicitly built. Its first boundary rank is 27 by connectivity. Sparse rank modulo 1000003 equals 100 and supplies a rigorous lower bound on rational rank. Triangles span graph H1 and admit disjoint stationary vertices; their resulting configuration loops surject onto graph H1 of rank 17, implying rational rank of second boundary at most 144-27-17=100. Hence b1=17,b2=56. Signed actions on all cells by every one of the 384 automorphisms commute with both boundaries, so Euler-character trace subtraction from graph H1 gives actual H2 characters in all twenty B4 classes. Character averages give quotient Betti numbers.

value.rationale: The four-dimensional cross-polytope is the first nonplanar member of the cross-polytope skeleton sequence after the octahedron. Its 56-dimensional degree-two homology module has 20 hyperoctahedral class values; these cannot be inferred from the Betti vector and resolve the difference between full quotient acyclicity, 2 surviving axis-permutation classes, and 3+3 independent sign-flip quotient classes. This is a mathematically natural complete finite symmetry classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or merely a numerical rank.
